content.comment_body: Hello, please review the attached file. I'm unsure what caused the issue—does anyone know how to expand the programming interface? Thanks in advance.
Hello [user_name], have you tried using the page layout button on the programming toolbar? Alternatively, use the control key on the keyboard and scroll with your mouse.

Hi, close [product_name] and go to the following folder on your computer: C:/user/. Inside, you'll find a folder named .[product_name]x.x. Delete that folder and restart [product_name]. This should revert settings to default and may solve your problem. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports that the interface of a [company_name] programming software has become unusably small, impacting productivity. Other participants suggest using toolbar buttons, keyboard and mouse shortcuts, and resetting the software configuration by deleting its folder to address the issue. The thread centers on resizing and recovering the software interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the programming software interface to remain functional and be easily resizable. They are seeking simple and immediate ways to restore or adjust the interface should any problems arise.
